changes: Expanded the energy-delivery and financial-statement evidence.
Removed extended protected-source summaries and retained one bounded factual forecast reference.
Preserved publication date, URLs, grouping, tags, active illustration and its rights record.
Removed duplicate narrative and numerical content from a retired chart record without restoring the asset.

sources.rights: Ordinary protected source; limited factual use
CC BY 4.0; condensed and translated text with attribution, adaptation and non-endorsement notices; no photos, logos, cover art or third-party graphics
Government-authored educational text; SEC website expressly permits reuse

sourceUse.method: Five-language aggregate using locale-aware word segmentation; ISO dates count as one unit; URLs and Markdown syntax excluded. Includes headlines, descriptions, SEO, footnotes, captions and public administrative reuse. Multi-source explanations are charged conservatively to both supporting reusable sources.

protectedWork.directQuotation: Only the English source title; translated titles in the other four editions. No body quotation.
protectedWork.excludedContent: No prior annual trajectory, scenario range, equipment-cycle assumptions or third-party studies retained.

IEA.basis: CC BY 4.0; report findings condensed, adapted and translated with attribution and required responsibility/non-endorsement notices.

SEC.basis: SEC-authored educational text under explicit website reuse policy.

sourceUse.limitation: This is an editorial source-use check, not a legal determination.

evidenceBoundary: The energy report was published in 2025: past-year estimates and future scenarios are identified separately.
Delay exposure is conditional, not a count of completed delays.
Electricity consumption is not treated as revenue or investment return.
Project financing implications are conditional applications of the cited energy and accounting evidence; no company solvency claim or personalised financial recommendation.

media.visualDisclosure: AI-generated conceptual illustration in every edition
